parameters.description: French Meadows Reservoir is a CDFW target fishery for hatchery catchables; the reservoir is on Tahoe National Forest land and lies within a State Game Refuge where hunting and discharge of firearms are prohibited. The dam and reservoir are owned and operated by the Placer County Water Agency (PCWA), which supplements CDFW stocking with its own trout plants (roughly twice yearly, before Memorial Day and again in mid-July).

candidates.summary: State Game Refuge (no hunting/firearms); reservoir owned/operated by PCWA, which supplements CDFW stocking with its own trout plants

schedule.note: Placer County Water Agency (dam/reservoir operator) stocks catchable-size rainbow trout roughly twice a year — once before Memorial Day (late May) and again in mid-July — sometimes in coordination with CDFW; a June 2026 release delivered 3,000 pounds of rainbow trout. CDFW's own historical stocking (5,000 lbs of catchable rainbow trout in 2014, per USFS) is not part of the current provisional CDFW stocking plan (French Meadows Reservoir does not appear in CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon), so this reflects PCWA-driven stocking rather than a guaranteed CDFW annual constant.
